verdict.rationale: Foreloop's model is bring-your-own-agent: you run Claude Code or Codex in a checkout on your own machine, and it pulls approved tasks from Foreloop (docs-3, docs-37). Any MCP client can also connect using just the endpoint URL and a Foreloop API key (docs-19), so the coding work runs on whatever model your own agent uses. Foreloop's hosted agents, which fill in intentions and review PRs, have no documented option to bring your own LLM or provider key, and the API keys shown are Foreloop keys, not model-provider keys. Missing for 10: explicit BYO LLM/provider-key configuration, model selection for Foreloop's own hosted agents, documentation of supported models beyond Claude Code/Codex, independent corroboration.
